entry.title: New: Bill 108 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Passed Second Reading
entry.content:
AMENDS ORDINANCE NO. 25-45, AS AMENDED, THE OPERATING BUDGET OF THE COUNTY OF HAWAIʻI FOR THE FISCAL YEAR ENDING JUNE 30, 2026

Increases revenues in the State Grants – State Emergency Medical Services account ($1,750,000)
